title: When to Pay for a Check: code, data and pre-registered experiments
description: Code, data, cached model outputs, pre-registrations and raw results for the article "When to Pay for a Check: Cost-Aware Checking and Switching for LLM Tool-Use Agents Under Silent Tool Degradation". It contains a simulator of priced tools that degrade silently, live tool services backed by small local models, a per-call rule that decides when to check, how to resolve a flag and when to switch tools, every baseline, the analysis code, and a script (reproduce_paper.py) that replays the reported experiments. Everything runs on a CPU. The source code is released under the MIT License. Data files keep the licences of their sources: GSM8K (MIT) and FreshQA-derived files (Apache-2.0). CostBench task routes are not included, because CostBench has no licence file; tools/costbench_routes.py rebuilds them from the public CostBench repository.
